action-timing.schema.json.title: Studio observed v3 recording action timing
action-timing.schema.json.description: One reading on the guided recording timeline (AR-1 R2, STUDIO-OBS-013). Shared by result.actionTimings (via result#/definitions/actionTiming) and bridge#/definitions/recordingEvidence.timings. clarificationWait and prefixReplay are reserved for OBS-015.

assignment.schema.json.title: Observed v3 immutable pre-context assignment
assignment.schema.json.description: Controller intent only. No browser, owner grant or lease exists until the actual worker validates its own claim response.

assignment-receipt.schema.json.title: Observed v3 scoped assignment receipt
assignment-receipt.schema.json.description: OWNED requires a validated live worker claim; ownerFence equals expectedFence + 1 and leaseExpiresAt never exceeds assignment.expiresAt. STOPPED can retain the historical grant or have both grant fields null; it never permits launch or renewal. Cross-record/runtime checks enforce relationships and liveness.

reason.description: PUBLISHED is the stop of a session whose learn published a revision: the runner discards the session recording before upload (no object, no manifest, no recording-evidence callback). It is emitted only from the publication commit; every other path keeps its reason and keeps the recording.

binding.schema.json.title: Observed v3 final exercised binding metadata
binding.schema.json.description: Final exercised metadata only. No local availability or runtime values; producer-before-consumer provenance requires cross-record verification.

reason.description: PUBLISHED is the stop of a session whose learn published a revision: the runner discards the session recording before upload (no object, no manifest, no recording-evidence callback). It is emitted only from the publication commit; every other path keeps its reason and keeps the recording.

errorMessage.description: Already-redacted failure diagnostic; redact actual resolved/known values before bounding or serialization. Not replay authority.

learned-plan.schema.json.title: Observed v3 exercised-plan candidate
learned-plan.schema.json.description: Contract for exact exercised metadata and initial-context precondition. It does not implement lowering, publication or replay readiness.

locator.schema.json.title: Studio observed v3 locator: closed, exact-only grammar, synthesized and verified by the runner
locator.schema.json.description: An array of at most 8 steps applied left to right from the page. Also enforced by the runner validateLocator (not expressible in draft-07): nth only as the last step, filterHas never first, and at most 8 steps counting the steps inside filterHas.

observation-refresh.schema.json.title: Observed v3 explicit observation refresh
observation-refresh.schema.json.description: Controller request for a fresh read-only observation from the current owned context. Existing observation callback remains commit authority. This command cannot navigate, resolve a clarification or execute an authored action.
